meta.title: WordPress Museum: 0.7
meta.description: A time-capsule post for WordPress 0.7, released May 27, 2003.
meta.author: wordpress-playground

steps.code:
<?php
if (!defined('ABSPATH')) {
	require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
}

global $wpdb;

function wordpress_museum_sql_escape($value) {
	return str_replace("'", "''", $value);
}

$title = wordpress_museum_sql_escape(base64_decode('TXVzZXVtIERpc3BhdGNoOiBXb3JkUHJlc3MgMC43'));
$content = wordpress_museum_sql_escape(base64_decode(''));
$now = '2003-05-27 10:00:00';
// WordPress 0.7 ships a far simpler posts schema than 1.0, so update the
// default first post in place using only columns present in that release.
$wpdb->query(
	"UPDATE " . $wpdb->posts . " SET post_title = '$title', post_content = '$content', post_date = '$now' WHERE ID = 1"
);
